name: Edict of the Hearth (Dimmed)
text: The hearth-page still holds, barely. The well sings beneath it, and the warmth is thin.

name: Edict of the Choir
text: Here, the ink sings, and fire forgets how to spread. Echoes rise.

name: Edict of Clear Water
text: Here, water remembers being clean. Wounds close slowly; Fray washes away.

name: Edict of Return (Broken)
text: With the bell silenced, the dead of the Hush rest. Echoes no longer rise.
